newsitem.title: USA: Canadian spot gas rises on cold, withdrawal limits.
newsitem.headline: Canadian spot gas rises on cold, withdrawal limits.

text.p: Canadian spot natural gas prices were sharply higher Monday, led by cold forecasts and withdrawal limits at the AECO storage hub, market sources said.
At the AECO storage hub, early prices surged to as high as C$3.70 per gigajoule (GJ) as only firm gas withdrawals were allowable.
Gas withdrawals were limited to only firm customers because storage had dipped below 50 percent of capacity due to the prolonged cold in the province, traders said.
